# GitHub Copilot Instructions for SnapNest

This is the SnapNest photo gallery application — a web app built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

## Using Claude Models in VS Code

To use Claude models with GitHub Copilot in VS Code:

1. Make sure you have the [GitHub Copilot](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=GitHub.copilot) and [GitHub Copilot Chat](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=GitHub.copilot-chat) extensions installed.
2. Open the Copilot Chat panel (Ctrl+Alt+I or Cmd+Alt+I on macOS).
3. Click the model selector dropdown at the top of the chat panel.
4. Select the desired Claude model (e.g., **Claude Sonnet** or **Claude Opus**) from the list.

> **Note:** Claude model availability depends on your GitHub Copilot subscription plan and the models currently offered by GitHub Copilot. If a specific model version is no longer listed, it may have been updated or replaced — check the model picker for the latest available options.

## Project Structure

- `index.html` — Landing page
- `albums.html` — Albums listing page
- `album-detail.html` — Individual album view
- `css/` — Stylesheets
- `js/` — JavaScript files
- `php/` — PHP backend scripts
- `data/` — JSON data storage
- `images/` — Static image assets
